## Joy‑Con Testing Checklist

- [ ] Tested with Joy‑Con L vertically (pair mode)
- [ ] Tested with Joy‑Con R vertically (pair mode)
- [ ] Tested with Joy‑Con L horizontally (solo mode, 90° counter-clockwise)
- [ ] Tested with Joy‑Con R horizontally (solo mode, 90° clockwise)
- [ ] All mapped buttons respond correctly (`L`, `ZL`, `SL`, `SR`, `−`, `Capture`, D‑pad, stick)
- [ ] All mapped buttons respond correctly (`R`, `ZR`, `SL`, `SR`, `+`, `Home`, `X`, `Y`, `A`, `B`, stick)
- [ ] Gyroscope / accelerometer (if applicable) reads correctly
- [ ] Connection/disconnection events are detected
- [ ] No latency introduced; input polling is smooth
- [ ] Other controllers are not affected
